sql-set.sql: SELECT "Es"."Id", "Es"."CorrelationId", "Es"."AuditableRequestId", "Es"."AuditableRequestName", "Es"."AuditableAssemblyQualifiedName", "Es"."AuditableSourceEventName", "Es"."CreatedDateTime", "Es"."ApiName", "Es"."CollectionName", "Es"."EventDataBinary", "Es"."UserId"::text , "Es"."OperationType" FROM app."EventStore_apidesign" as "Es" Where 1=1 #JOIN_CLAUSE# #WHERE_CLAUSE# ORDER BY {0} {1} OFFSET (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize Limit @PageSize ;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Es"."Id") FROM app."EventStore_apidesign" AS "Es" Where 1=1 #JOIN_CLAUSE# #WHERE_CLAUSE#; --WHERE "Es"."IsDeleted" = FALSE
